# Version 3.119.4
> **Broad platform servicing** · Released May 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.4)

> **Supersedes [3.119.3](3.119.3.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands supported platforms and fixes graphics view reliability across desktop and mobile. The release adds Linux Bionic and GTK4 support while improving Android, tvOS, Tizen, and Windows deployment.

## Breaking Changes

- **Blazor imports no longer inherit ComponentBase** — The generated Blazor _Imports type no longer implements the component interfaces. Do not derive application components or behavior from that generated import type.

## Platform

- **Linux, GTK4, Tizen, and .NET Framework support expanded** — Adds Linux Bionic assets and Gtk4 views, expands Tizen native architectures, and adds net48 validation support. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3527), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3631))
- **tvOS native delivery corrected** — Separates device and simulator native targets so tvOS applications receive the appropriate framework assets. ([#3561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3561), [#3563](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3563))

## Bug Fixes

- **View rendering reliability improved** — Fixes Android MAUI tab-switch rendering and a Cairo assertion crash in GTK4 drawing areas. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#3562](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3562))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.5

Updates HarfBuzz platform packaging alongside the expanded Linux, Tizen, tvOS, and .NET support.
